validation.unchanged_released_stock_oracle_method: ScalarFunctionsTest.testSign; stock oracle only, native work established by separate SQL witnesses

shared_state.scope: Existing shared-state controls run in each release/runtime pair. Admitted arithmetic proofs contain no UDF.

released_arithmetic_implementation.contract: Each DECIMAL-only +, - or * node retains its resolved precision/scale and overflow NULL. SIGN retains resolved precision/scale; noncompact p=s returns NULL for nonzero values and scaled zero for zero. Recursive SIGN and same-scale precision widening preserve the contract. Division, remainder, rescaling, narrowing, mixed numeric operands and unverified producers retain generated evaluation.

projection_default_regressions.scope: NOT NULL character, BOOLEAN, integer and approximate numeric final projections retain their released generated value/default/NULL-flag contract. Nullable and WHERE consumers retain NULL; direct DECIMAL ERROR/DROP enforcement remains intact. These mixed correctness paths are not claimed as JVM-free acceleration.

method.prepared_boundary: Released generated Java on prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData versus production Calc on matching Arrow. Operation and equivalent BOOLEAN/NULL consumption timed inside Rust for native execution and in Java for stock. method.controls: Actual independently recompiled preceding encoder binds the real generated SIGN evaluator, using the same expanded-fixture executable and unchanged production DSO as the candidate. Candidate requires empty descriptors and intended native function work. The actual preceding 69e4198f encoder includes the SIGN final-projection-default correctness repair. method.data: DECIMAL(18,2)/(19,19)/(38,18)/(38,38) signed extrema and large coefficients, nullable/NOT NULL schemas, NULL every seven rows only for nullable input. SIGN(v+v), SIGN(v*v) and SIGN((v+v)*v), each consumed by >0 OR CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN). The nullable consumer retains overflow NULL even for NOT NULL inputs. This measures arithmetic SIGN through a BOOLEAN consumer, not final DECIMAL output timing. 1024-row bulk and 16-row multiplication controls.

method.pipeline: Million-row nullable DECIMAL(18,2) addition and DECIMAL(38,18) multiplication/nested and DECIMAL(38,38) multiplication producers with the same BOOLEAN consumers. Rowwise source/blackhole, parallelism one, two warmups/five measurements. Planning/startup, source generation, production JNI and both transposes retained. Require consumed NativeCalc, no fallback and empty candidate descriptors; actual previous path retains generated evaluators.
